experiment.claim: One of four variants of #169's initial-condition screen at 125 C / 50 mA, which re-tests #81 item 2 (a reported second, stable, non-regulating equilibrium: tt -> VOUT 2.093 V, FB 1.114 V, N_FBB 1.048 V; ss -> 2.014 V; fs -> 2.199 V) after #164 showed the method it rested on -- a `tran ... uic` with only v(vout) constrained -- is unreliable at the far gentler 27 C / 1 mA corner. The four variants run ONE circuit (sim/dropout-vs-load's DUT, C_OUT and ideal 50 mA load, VIN held at the corner supply) and vary ONLY the initial condition: V = #81's own contract (`.ic v(vout)=1.8` only, `uic`); F = the same `uic` analysis with all eleven nodes #169 names seeded at their intended-branch values; B = #164's variant-B contract (the same full `.ic`, no `uic`: constrained `.op`, then released); C = cold start from all-zero with the EN edge and the load ramped on once the loop is up. If F/B/C all settle inside the regulating window with a realizable node set while V does not, item 2 is a method artifact; if F/B/C also settle at #81's ~2.0-2.2 V state with all four realizability slacks >= 0, item 2 is a real second equilibrium. THIS VARIANT (C) is #169 Scope item 2's cold half: every node at 0 V, EN low until 100 us, the ideal 50 mA sink ramped on over 2.5-2.6 ms once the loop is up (an ideal sink on a disabled, discharged output is not a realizable state), settled to 6 ms. From 2.6 ms on the circuit is element-for-element V/F/B's. SUBSTANTIATES NO SPEC ROW: this is diagnostic evidence for design/README.md's "#169" section, kept in its own experiment slug for the same reason #164's screen was (sim/mc-ic-screen-a/-b/-d): measurements/build_characterization_report.py resolves a spec row's evidence from the lexicographically last record under the slug EVIDENCE_MAP maps it to, nothing maps to this slug, and a screen record must never be picked up as sim/dropout-vs-load's Dropout-row evidence. The vout_ss window is the ratified Output row's verbatim only so that 'regulating' has one fixed meaning across the four variants.
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix diagnostic screen, not a distribution claim)
